facts.description: A highly customizable way to play chess in your terminal. Play online (via Lichess.org) and offline against the Fairy-Stockfish engine. All Lichess variants are supported.

research.name: cli-chess
research.note: Terminal chess client with a colored Unicode board, playable offline against Fairy-Stockfish or online through Lichess, including watching Lichess TV.

effects: colored Unicode chess board in the terminal with last-move square highlighting
live Lichess TV spectating in the terminal with player names, ratings and clocks
function-key action bar (flip board, takeback, resign) under a typed move prompt
